methodology: Candidate lists for Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House 1, Executive Council 3, State Senate 21 and the seven Rockingham House districts covering Portsmouth come from Ballotpedia race pages fetched 2026-10-29, cross-checked against Citizens Count election and district pages. Rockingham County office candidate lists could not be read directly from sos.nh.gov (the 2026 election details page returned a client error and direct download was not permitted); they come from The Ballot Brief race pages, which state they are drawn from the NH Secretary of State certified filing list (last verified by that site 2026-10-24). Treat county rosters as secondary-sourced until confirmed against sos.nh.gov. Positions are copied from Citizens Count candidate profiles (issue survey answers or quotes Citizens Count attributes to a debate, website or news outlet), Ballotpedia Candidate Connection surveys, or campaign site pages that were fetched; stances are the candidate's own words or the survey label, not characterizations. Candidate campaign sites for Pappas, Sununu, Shaheen, DiLorenzo, Kennedy Sheldon, Stevens, Villee, Perkins Kwoka and Anna Howard could not be fetched in this session (permission blocked), so their positions rely on Citizens Count and Ballotpedia. Bluesky profile pages could not be fetched; the one Bluesky handle listed (Warmington) comes from her campaign site's link and is not independently confirmed. YouTube channel ids were read from the channel pages. The 'what' and 'term' fields are general descriptions of each office and were not sourced per race in this session. Ward-to-district mapping is from the City of Portsmouth's State and National Officials page and the NH SOS 2022 Rockingham House results document. Jonathan Kiper (independent, governor) is listed as withdrawn by Ballotpedia and 'dropped out' by Citizens Count and is excluded. Incumbents in the House districts without an opponent: Scherr (26), G. Ward (27), Sorensen (28). No Republican filed in Rockingham 21, 22, 26, 27, 28 or 37 per Ballotpedia.
